faq: Flipkart or Amazon?
If the final price is about the same, buy from Amazon. Its delivery, returns and service are generally more reliable. Some phones are sold on only one of them, and each pick here says where.
Why is everything pricier than July?
Prices have gone up across phones and laptops this year, mostly because memory chips got costlier with the AI boom. Many models were cheaper in July. These picks are the best value at today's prices.
phones
laptops
Should I wait for the Diwali sale?
Don't expect big drops later. Prices are trending up, not down. If you need it, buy now.
Is exchange worth it?
Only if the exchange value beats what Cashify or OLX would give you. Check the quoted value before you place the order.
Are iPhones a good deal this sale?
Not really. Discounts on the iPhone 15, 16 and 17 are small this year. Buy only if you're already on iPhone; don't switch for the deal.
phones
Is 70% off real?
Ruko! Many listings show a made-up MRP. Judge the final price, not the percentage.
No-cost EMI, any catch?
There's usually a small processing fee, and GST on the interest. Check the final amount on the payment page.
Is it 4G or 5G?
Check the listing title and specs before paying. Some sale listings mix 4G and 5G versions of the same phone at similar prices.
phones
Anything else before ordering?
For phones, TVs and laptops, record a video while unboxing. It makes returns easy if something is wrong.
